svg.title: Results at a glance
svg.desc: Results at a glance. Removing cell types in order of output synapses halves sensory-to-motor flow capacity after 4.1% of 11,751 types; random removal needs 28.3% (95% CI 27.7% to 28.9%). At each strategy's half-flow point at most 37 types have lost every path from sensory input; at 50.25% removed, 5,306 of 5,846 surviving types are cut off under sensory-motor betweenness against 1 at random. Removing the connections with the most synapses first halves routing after 26.8% of connections, against 47.6% at random. A single batch of sensory-motor betweenness removal cuts off 6,046 types at once.
